landing.tagline: Pray for the unreached, one people group at a time
landing.intro: Each time you pray, you'll be given a different unreached people group — those least covered in prayer come first. Join believers worldwide carrying these peoples to God.
landing.how_1: You're handed a people group that needs prayer.
landing.how_2: Move through a short, guided prayer stack.
landing.how_3: When you're done, pray for another.
